OUR GOALS
From fragmented systems to sustainable value

JISR by WASL
JISR (جسر) is an initiative by WASL designed to build a bridge between Yemeni and regional/global expertise. JISR addresses the systematic gaps faced by entrepreneurs in underserved economies: the lack of structured mentorship, limited entrepreneurial skills, and minimal access to regional networks.
JISR’s vision is to enable a resilient entrepreneurial ecosystem in Yemen, leading to sustainable economic recovery through job creation and innovation.
MASAR by WASL
A university-based student-to-startup capacity building program designed to transform Yemeni students from learners to entrepreneurs through a structured, practice-based pathway. The program responds to a critical gap in the Yemeni context: while many students have ambition, talent, and ideas, very few have access to a practical system that helps them validate problems, build solutions, and turn early concepts into operational startups.
WOMEN-LED BUSINESSES
A diagnostic-led business improvement incubator combining structured advisory, hands-on implementation support, specialist referrals, and targeted group learning. Every selected business completes the same structured diagnostic and agrees on a focused Business Improvement Plan addressing 2–3 highest-priority bottlenecks. Advisory time, specialist inputs, and group labs are activated against those priorities rather than delivered as a fixed curriculum.
ESOs CAPACITY BUILDING
A capacity-building program for entrepreneurship support organizations in Yemen, designed to strengthen incubator and accelerator managers & operators with practical tools, methodologies, and operating models to design and deliver more effective startup support programs.

WASL means “وصل” … to connect
OUR CONCEPT
10
CONNECT
A credible, intelligent, and human-centered connector.
WASL comes from the Arabic word “وصل”, meaning “connect.” The name reflects the organization’s core role: connecting founders to opportunity, institutions to credible startups, and fragmented ecosystem actors to one another.
FOUNDER + ECOSYSTEM READINESS
What distinguishes WASL is that it works on both sides of the equation: founder readiness and ecosystem readiness.
TRUST INFRASTRUCTURE
WASL goes deeper by building the underlying trust infrastructure that early-stage ecosystems lack. It strengthens the relationships, capabilities, and market conditions that allow entrepreneurship to become sustainable and scalable.
WASL is not only a program operator; it builds the trust, relationships, and infrastructure required for entrepreneurship to work in underserved and fragile markets.
